# AI Data Analyst & Project Manager

## About the Role

GovCIO is hiring an **AI Data Analyst & Project Manager** to support **VA CAIO initiatives** in a federal environment. This role combines data analytics, project management, program coordination, and executive support to help gather, analyze, and report on AI adoption and outcomes.

The position will coordinate planning, milestones, and deliverables across multiple teams while supporting initiatives in a fast-paced environment. This is a **fully remote role within the United States**.

## Key Responsibilities

* Gather data related to AI adoption and outcomes.

* Analyze AI adoption and performance data to identify relevant insights.

* Prepare and report data and findings for stakeholders.

* Coordinate project planning across multiple teams.

* Track project milestones and deliverables.

* Support cross-functional teams in maintaining progress against project objectives.

* Provide executive support for VA CAIO initiatives.

* Coordinate activities across multiple teams in a fast-paced federal environment.

## Required Qualifications

* Experience with **data analytics**, including gathering, analyzing, and reporting data.

* Experience with **project or program management**, including planning, milestones, and deliverables.

* Ability to coordinate work across multiple teams.

* Ability to communicate data and project information clearly to stakeholders.

* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced federal environment.

## Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting **AI adoption initiatives** or analyzing AI-related outcomes.

* Experience in a federal government environment.

* Experience providing executive support for technology or AI programs.

## Skills & Competencies

* Data analysis and reporting.

* AI adoption and outcomes analysis.

* Project and program coordination.

* Milestone and deliverable tracking.

* Cross-functional collaboration.

* Executive support.

* Stakeholder communication.

* Planning and organizational skills.

## Education & Experience

* The source description does not specify a required degree, certification, or minimum number of years of experience.

## Work Arrangement & Schedule

* **Work Arrangement:** Fully remote.

* **Location:** United States.

* **Environment:** Fast-paced federal environment.

## Compensation & Benefits

* Compensation and benefits are not specified in the source description.

## Compliance / Additional Information

* The position supports **VA CAIO initiatives**.

* The role is fully remote within the United States.

Job Title:
Insurance Subject Matter Expert (AI Training)

Location:
Remote (Must work PST business hours)

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Insurance Subject Matter Expert (SME)
to support the development, evaluation, and improvement of AI models used across insurance processes. The ideal candidate will work closely with AI, data science, and product teams to ensure AI systems are accurate, compliant, and aligned with industry standards and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Evaluate AI models used in underwriting, claims processing, risk assessment, and pricing.
Identify model gaps, biases, and opportunities for improvement using insurance domain expertise.
Validate AI outputs against insurance practices, regulatory requirements, and customer experience standards.
Define key performance metrics and success criteria for AI models.
Support data labeling and annotation with insurance-specific knowledge.
Contribute to explainable AI initiatives to improve model transparency and trust.
Stay current with insurance regulations, compliance standards, and AI trends in the insurance industry.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Insurance, Risk Management, Actuarial Science, Business, or a related field.
7+ years of insurance industry experience in areas such as underwriting, claims, risk modeling, or product management.
Strong understanding of insurance operations, policy structures, and regulatory frameworks.
Experience working with cross-functional teams.
Must be available to work 35-40 hours per week during regular PST business hours.

jobs.title: Research Associate
jobs.description:
Location: Santa Monica, CA 90404

Duration: 12 Months

Position Summary

The Research Associate, Analytical Sciences will be responsible for the execution of routine testing, including but not limited to molecular biology assays and cell-based assays and to characterize T cell therapy processes and products. Additionally, this role contributes to the daily operational tasks in the Analytical Sciences team. This role is based in Santa Monica, CA.

Essential Functions And Responsibilities

Perform routine analytical testing to characterize cell products or processes primarily using DNA/RNA extraction/quantification, dPCR, live cell imaging, and plate-based assays.
Accurately complete eLN documentation contemporaneously for the lab work in which it pertains to.
Participate in eLN template drafting, revisions, and ensure executable templates are comprehensive.
Participate in tracking assay results and test method performance parameters.
Assist in everyday operation of analytical laboratories, including but not limited to equipment management, lab maintenance and restocking, and reagent inventory.
Support cross-functional projects with process development, manufacturing, quality control, and quality assurance groups.

Responsibilities

What the Role Entails (Day-to-Day Responsibilities)

Sample Processing & Genomics:
Daily processing of samples using genomic workflows (DNA extractions, running PCR / dPCR).
Culturing, handling, and preparing human T cells / mammalian cells.

Lab Operations & Inventory:
Managing reagent inventory and placing orders for consumables as they are used.
Reporting instrument issues/faults to ensure quick maintenance and calibration.

Data Analysis & Documentation:
Performing basic data analysis and maintaining standard lab records/documentation.

Required Skills/Abilities

Hands-on experience in performing and analyzing qPCR/dPCR and/or cell-based assays is preferred.
Detail-oriented in both technical assay execution and data analysis.
Must be eager to learn and willing to ask questions.
Experience in flow cytometry assays and equipment/software is a plus.
Enjoy a fast-paced, dynamic team and company environment and able to adjust tasks based upon changing priorities.

Education And Experience

MS Degree in Biology, Chemistry, or related discipline with relevant experience.
BS degree in Biology, Chemistry, or related discipline with 1 years of relevant experience.
Experience working in a regulated environment (e.g. GMP, GLP, or CLIA) is a plus.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to:

Sit, stand, walk and communicate verbally (i.e. speak and hear).
The employee is frequently required to use their hands and arms to reach and grasp (i.e. tactile functioning).
The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus in order to read.
The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
May be required to travel by plane or car 5% of the time
This position requires working with biological and/or chemical hazards

jobs.description:
Department Information

Vision

We enhance public safety and promote successful community reintegration through education, treatment and active participation in rehabilitative and restorative justice programs.

Mission

To facilitate the successful reintegration of the individuals in our care back to their communities equipped with the tools to be drug-free, healthy, and employable members of society by providing education, treatment, rehabilitative, and restorative justice programs, all in a safe and humane environment.

CDCR and CCHCS are committed to transforming the correctional landscape to create safer, more professional, and more fulfilling environments for our employees, the incarcerated population, and those supervised in our communities. Through systemwide improvements grounded in proven and emerging practices, we aim to strengthen rehabilitation, enhance workplace satisfaction, and support successful reentry into the community through our institutions, parole, and community partnerships. Our shared mission is to promote safety, wellness, and human dignity while fostering positive change for all those who live and work within our institutions and communities

CDCR and CCHCS are committed to building an inclusive respectful workplace. We are determined to attract and hire candidates from all communities and empower employees from a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and personal experiences. We are proud to foster inclusion and drive collaborative efforts at all levels of the Department.

Across our organization, our programs work cooperatively to provide the highest level of health care possible to a diverse correctional population. We encourage creativity and ingenuity while treating others fairly, honestly, and with respect, all of which are critical to the success of the CDCR and CCHCS mission.

This advertisement is for a Senior Laboratory Assistant, Correctional Facility position(s) located at Centinela State Prison (CEN) in Imperial, in Imperial County. Please indicate the position number on your application: 403-000-9266-XXX.

Note:
Main communication for this position will be through email. Please ensure you have a valid email address on your application.

Department Website: https://cchcs.ca.gov/careers

Job Description And Duties

Effective July 1, 2025, in accordance with the applicable Memorandum of Understanding, the Personal Leave Program 2025 (PLP 2025) was implemented in response to the status of the State budget. PLP 2025 requires each full-time employee in Bargaining Unit 11, and related Excluded, Exempt and Statutory Exempt employees, will have their base salary reduced by 3 percent and will receive 5 PLP 2025 leave credits monthly through June 2027. Salaries do not reflect the recent changes. Part-time employees are subject to the same conditions as full-time employees, on a prorated basis equivalent to their time-base. Permanent intermittent employees are subject to the same condition as full-time employees, based on the number of hours worked in the pay period.

This is a limited term position which may be extended or become permanent.

Under the supervision of the Correctional Health Services Administrator I/II, Correctional Facility (CF), the Senior Laboratory Assistant, CF performs standardized non-technical laboratory procedures in collecting and processing laboratory specimens, materials, and supplies. Assists in operating specialized laboratory equipment. Complies with all the applicable State and federal laws and regulations and departmental policies and procedures pertaining to the laboratory. May act in a lead capacity for laboratory assistants. Maintains order and supervises the conduct of the incarcerated and protects and maintains the safety of persons and property.

Please note: Individuals who are eligible for a Training and Development assignment may also be considered for this position(s).

You will find additional information about the job in the Duty Statement
.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The State of California is an equal opportunity employer to all, regardless of age, ancestry, color, disability (mental and physical), exercising the right to family care and medical leave, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, military or veteran status, national origin, political affiliation, race, religious creed, sex (includes pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and related medical conditions), and sexual orientation.

It is an objective of the State of California to achieve a drug-free work place. Any applicant for state employment will be expected to behave in accordance with this objective because the use of illegal drugs is inconsistent with the law of the State, the rules governing Civil Service, and the special trust placed in public servants.

jobs.title: Clinical Lab Scientist-Lead- Transfusion
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Summary:
The Clinical Lab Scientist-Lead serves as an advanced-level resource responsible for coordinating complex testing activities, ensuring workflow continuity, and promoting adherence to quality and regulatory standards. Applies in-depth technical knowledge to assist with problem-solving, validation, and process optimization. Collaborates closely with peers, Supervisors, and leadership to support operational readiness, quality improvement, and staff development. Provides technical mentorship, facilitates communication, and contributes to the integration of new methods, technologies, and best practices. Performs other duties as needed.

Education and Experience:
Bachelor's Degree required. Two years of experience in a high complexity, computerized clinical laboratory as a licensed Clinical Lab Scientist required.

Knowledge and Skills:
Possesses excellent dexterity and ability to plan and organize technical work, manage workload, operate technical instruments and equipment, input data and type. Possesses clear speaking abilities in English. Possesses excellent and effective verbal and written communication skills in English matching the style to the message and the audience. Maintains excellent interpersonal relationships with all customers (e.g., staff, patients, vendors). Ability to use available resource material independently to resolve and document challenges constructively. Provides staff and management with timely information, constructive and actionable feedback. Fosters cooperation and collaboration, actively solicits opinions from others. Builds respect and trust. Inspires staff with enthusiasm for the strategic plan. Must be able to supervise, lead, and teach CLS staff. Explains and teaches. Responds to guidance constructively. Detail oriented. Able to reason and solve problems effectively, analyze and interpret data. Able to organize work, to service multiple requests and tasks at one time, while maintaining quality and a professional manner. Self-motivated and works well with minimal direction. Articulates logical and well-founded arguments that support conclusions. Possesses excellent analytic skills. Ability to hear sufficiently for general conversation in person and on the telephone, and identify and distinguish various sounds associated with workplace/patient care; see adequately to read computer screens, medical records, and written documents necessary to the position; discern temperature variances through touch.

Licensures and Certifications:
California Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) Generalist MTA license is required. For Histocompatibility, a California Clinical Histocompatibility Scientist MTR license is acceptable. Specialty certification in area overseen preferred.
